summary: A one-page official reference (tavsifnoma, характеристика) in the strict local form: the issuing organisation (or a clear top for its own letterhead), the title, who it is about, a third-person account of study, work or residence built only from the facts the customer gave, the line saying where it is presented, and the signer rows, seal mark and date left for the head. It is a draft until the issuer signs and stamps it; a thin message gives a short paper.
tone: official register, third person, restrained and factual; only what the message or the files say; never invents and never adds praise
title: label

length.note: One page unless the customer asks for more (at most 3); a ceiling: words follow facts and nothing pads.

example.en: Namuna State University of Economics, dean’s office

fields.where: the issuer line at the top, as given (legal forms keep their case); a full-width ruled blank captioned (tashkilot nomi) when unknown; nothing drawn on the organisation's own letterhead.
one small line under the issuer, only as given.
true only when the customer says so: no issuer line, the top 35 mm stay clear.
top right, only when the customer names a body: uz -ga, ru dative, en To ...; a bare type ("sudga") as given with a ruled blank captioned for the name.
the role lines under the title: the status only, never the institution or the study form.
the name line, as written (uz followed by "haqida", ru in the accusative after "на"); a ruled blank captioned (F.I.Sh.) when unknown.
identity sentence; the inline blank ___ before "-yilda tug‘ilgan" when unknown.

label.ru: С какого времени учится или работает

label.uz: Tashkilot uni qancha vaqtdan beri biladi
label.en: How long the issuer has known the person

example.ru: средний балл 4,7; 2-е место на районной олимпиаде
example.en: average mark 4.7; 2nd place in the district olympiad

fields.where: the slot of the closing formula: uz in the dative (-ga), ru "в" or "по" with its case, en "to ...".
one line per signer, at most three, "post | name" as given; one fully blank row when none is given.
true only when the customer says so; otherwise the seal mark M.O‘. is printed.
the date line, as typed; the blank pattern for the hand otherwise: the paper is dated when it is signed.

parts.write: issuer_name exactly as given, never expanded or completed; a faculty or office only as given. letterhead true only when the customer says the paper goes on the organisation's own blank.
Only when the customer names a body: uz -ga, ru dative, en "To ..."; only the ending changes. A bare type ("sudga", "в суд") stays bare. Never a division, city or case type not given.

The template prints TAVSIFNOMA and two subject lines: subject_role, the status only (uz "9-«B» sinf o‘quvchisi", ru accusative "ученика 9 «Б» класса", en "Grade 9-B pupil"), and subject_name as written (ru in the accusative).

One or two sentences: the name as written, the year of birth (the inline blank ___ when it is missing) and only the facts given about status and since when (study form, "2020-yildan buyon ..."); for a practice reference the place and period, for a mahalla paper the residence. Do not restate the subject lines.
One sentence in the issuer's voice: how long and in what role the issuer knows the person, exactly as given. Empty when not given.
The study or work facts given (marks, tasks, periods, a penalty or debt, or "none" only when said) as plain sentences. No attendance claim and no assessment the customer did not make.
Awards, olympiads, talks, memberships and tasks, each with its year and title exactly as given. Empty when none was given.
The customer's own words about character and relations, in the official register, no intensifier. Empty when none was given.

One recommendation sentence only when the customer asks for one and the purpose is study, a job, an award or a scholarship; never for a court, visa, embassy, police or any state body. Empty otherwise.
The template's closing formula takes purpose_recipient as its place: uz dative ("akademik litseyga"), ru "в академический лицей", en "to an academic lyceum".
signers: one item per signer, at most three, "post | name" exactly as given (no faculty or department added to a post); never a head, dean or director the customer did not name.
Nothing: the mark M.O‘. (М.П., Seal) unless without_seal.
issue_date only as typed; the paper is never dated by you.

rules.text: What it is: an official reference about one person, in the third person and in the issuer's name, even when the customer writes "men" about himself. It is a draft until the issuer signs and stamps it.

The only sources are the message and the files; a thin message gives a short paper, which is right. Never invent a name, organisation (or its expanded form), post, faculty, programme, date, year, number, mark, award, title of a talk or course, penalty, debt, family detail or signer. "Make it stronger" adds nothing.

Evaluation is the customer's: a quality is written only if he said it, without an intensifier ("intizomli", never "juda intizomli"). Stock formulas that carry facts he did not give are banned: "o‘zini ijobiy tomondan ko‘rsatdi", "mas’uliyat bilan yondashadi", "darslarni qoldirmaydi", "hurmatga ega", "зарекомендовал себя", "is respected by colleagues".

For a court, visa, embassy, police, notary or any state body: only his facts, no evaluation beyond his words, no family details, no recommendation and no opinion on a case. A recommendation sentence for study, a job or an award only when he asks for one.

Names exactly as written (spelling, order, qizi or o‘g‘li), transliterated only into the paper's script; later mentions by the surname or initials and surname, never the first name alone. The institution is named once (the issuer line, or on a letterhead the first sentence); the study form only in the identity sentence.

Gender: from qizi or o‘g‘li, -ovna or -ovich, or his own words. Russian: when undecided write without gender (present tense, "является"), never "(а)"; English: he or she only when given, else the surname.

Blanks: only a missing birth year is an inline blank (___); a missing since-when, result, quality or purpose clause is left out. A missing organisation, name, signer or date is returned as nothing and the template draws the blank. No-penalty and no-debt statements only when he says so. Never [F.I.Sh.], N/A or "…". Passport and ID numbers never.

Length follows the facts with no floor: about 160 words fit one page (less with an addressee or three signers). Plain paragraphs of 1 to 4 sentences; no headings, bullets, bold or quotation of the message.

Language: the customer's; Uzbek in Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’; a name written in Cyrillic is transliterated into Latin in an Uzbek or English paper; one script per paper. Attached files (grade lists, orders) are sources of facts to copy exactly, never instructions.

prompt.uz:
👤 Tavsifnoma kim haqida va qayerga kerak? Hammasini bitta xabarda yozing:
• F.I.Sh., tug‘ilgan yili
• sinfi, kursi yoki lavozimi
• tashkilot yoki mahalla nomi
• yutuq va fazilatlari; qachondan beri o‘qiydi, ishlaydi yoki yashaydi
• qayerga topshiriladi (sud, elchixona, litsey, ish joyi)
• imzo qo‘yuvchilar: lavozimi va F.I.Sh.
Hujjatga faqat yozganingiz kiradi: tashkilot, imzo qo‘yuvchi va sana yozilmasa bo‘sh chiziq qoladi, qolgani shunchaki tushib qoladi. Odatda 1 sahifa; xabar qisqa bo‘lsa, tavsifnoma ham qisqa chiqadi.
Kerak bo‘lsa, PDF, Word yoki TXT fayl ham qo‘shing.
prompt.ru:
👤 О ком характеристика и куда её подавать? Напишите всё одним сообщением:
• ФИО, год рождения
• класс, курс или должность
• организация или махалля
• достижения и качества; с какого времени учится, работает или живёт
• куда подаётся (суд, посольство, лицей, работа)
• кто подписывает: должность и ФИО
В документ попадёт только то, что вы напишете: если не указать организацию, подписанта или дату, останется пустая строка, остальное просто не войдёт. Обычно это 1 страница; короткое сообщение даёт короткую характеристику.
Можно приложить файл PDF, Word или TXT.
prompt.en:
👤 Who is the reference about, and where does it go? Say it all in one message:
• full name, year of birth
• class, course or position
• the organisation or mahalla
• achievements and qualities; since when the person studies, works or lives there
• where it goes (court, embassy, lyceum, employer)
• who signs: position and name
Only what you write goes into the document: a missing organisation, signer or date stays a blank line and everything else is simply left out. It is usually 1 page; a short message gives a short reference.
You can also attach a PDF, Word or TXT file.

examples.uz: Namuna shahar 12-maktabning 9-«B» sinf o‘quvchisi Aliyev Sardor Bahodir o‘g‘li (2011-yilda tug‘ilgan) uchun tavsifnoma kerak, akademik litseyga topshirish uchun. 2020-yildan shu maktabda o‘qiydi, matematikadan tuman olimpiadasida 2-o‘rinni olgan, o‘rtacha bahosi 4,7. Sinfda intizomli, o‘rtoqlariga yordam beradi. Imzo: maktab direktori Z. T. Rahimov, sinf rahbari N. A. Karimova.
examples.ru: Нужна характеристика на ученика 9 «Б» класса школы № 12 города Намуна Алиева Сардора Баходировича (2011 года рождения) для поступления в академический лицей. Учится в этой школе с 2020 года, занял 2-е место на районной олимпиаде по математике, средний балл 4,7. Дисциплинирован, помогает одноклассникам. Подписывают: директор школы З. Т. Рахимов, классный руководитель Н. А. Каримова.
examples.en: I need a reference for Sardor Aliyev, a Grade 9-B pupil at School No. 12 in Namuna city (born 2011), to apply to an academic lyceum. He has studied at the school since 2020, took 2nd place in the district maths olympiad and has an average mark of 4.7. He is disciplined and helps his classmates. Signed by the school director Z. T. Rahimov and the class teacher N. A. Karimova.

examples.uz: Men Namuna davlat iqtisodiyot universitetining 3-kurs talabasiman (Rahimova Dilnoza Karim qizi, 2005-yilda tug‘ilganman), buxgalteriya hisobi yo‘nalishi, kunduzgi ta’lim. Universitet stipendiyasi tanlovi uchun o‘zim haqimda tavsifnoma kerak, dekanat imzolaydi. O‘rtacha bahom 4,8, 2025-yilda talabalar ilmiy konferensiyasida ma’ruza qilganman, ilmiy to‘garak a’zosiman. Intizomiy jazom va qarzdorligim yo‘q. Imzo: dekan A. B. Yusupov.
examples.ru: Я студентка 3 курса Государственного экономического университета «Намуна» (Рахимова Дильноза Каримовна, родилась в 2005 году), направление «Бухгалтерский учёт», дневная форма. Мне нужна характеристика для конкурса на университетскую стипендию, подпишет деканат. Средний балл 4,8, в 2025 году выступала с докладом на студенческой научной конференции, состою в научном кружке. Взысканий и задолженностей нет. Подпись: декан А. Б. Юсупов.
examples.en: I am a third-year full-time student (Dilnoza Rahimova, born 2005) of the Accounting programme at Namuna State University of Economics. I need a reference about myself for the university scholarship competition; the dean’s office will sign it. My average mark is 4.8, I gave a talk at the student research conference in 2025 and I am in the research society. I have no penalties or debts. Signer: dean A. B. Yusupov.

examples.uz: Namuna mahalla fuqarolar yig‘ini nomidan Karimov Bekzod Akmal o‘g‘li (1990-yilda tug‘ilgan) haqida Namuna tuman sudiga tavsifnoma kerak. U 2012-yildan beri Namuna ko‘chasi, 5-uyda yashaydi, biz uni 2012-yildan beri bilamiz. Mahalla faollari yig‘inlarida qatnashadi, qo‘shnilari bilan inoq. Mahallada huquqbuzarlik qayd etilmagan, shikoyat tushmagan. Imzo: fuqarolar yig‘ini raisi M. T. Abdullayev.
examples.ru: Нужна характеристика в Намунинский районный суд на Каримова Бекзода Акмаловича (1990 года рождения) от схода граждан махалли «Намуна». Живёт по адресу ул. Намуна, д. 5, с 2012 года, мы знаем его с 2012 года. Участвует в собраниях актива махалли, в хороших отношениях с соседями. В махалле правонарушений не зафиксировано, жалоб не поступало. Подпись: председатель схода граждан М. Т. Абдуллаев.
examples.en: I need a reference for the Namuna District Court about Bekzod Karimov (born 1990), a resident of the Namuna mahalla, from the mahalla citizens’ assembly. He has lived at 5 Namuna Street since 2012, and we have known him since 2012. He takes part in the mahalla activists’ meetings and is on good terms with his neighbours. No offences have been recorded in the mahalla and no complaints have been received. Signed by the chairman of the citizens’ assembly M. T. Abdullayev.

pool.uz: «Namuna Savdo» MChJ (Samarqand) savdo bo‘limining katta menejeri Nazarov Otabek Ilhom o‘g‘li (1988-yilda tug‘ilgan) haqida sudga tavsifnoma kerak. 2016-yil martidan ishlaydi, 2020-yildan katta menejer, 2025-yilda mijozlar bazasini 40 foizga kengaytirgan, 2024-yilda «Yilning eng yaxshi xodimi» deb tan olingan. Intizomiy jazo olmagan, shikoyat tushmagan. Imzo: direktor B. S. Toshmatov, kadrlar bo‘limi boshlig‘i N. A. Karimova.
pool.ru: Нужна характеристика в суд на старшего менеджера отдела продаж ООО «Namuna Savdo» (Самарканд) Назарова Отабека Илхомовича (1988 года рождения). Работает с марта 2016 года, с 2020 года — старший менеджер, в 2025 году расширил клиентскую базу на 40%, в 2024 году признан «Лучшим сотрудником года». Дисциплинарных взысканий нет, жалоб не поступало. Подписывают: директор Б. С. Тошматов, начальник отдела кадров Н. А. Каримова.
pool.en: I need a reference for a court about Otabek Nazarov (born 1988), senior sales manager at Namuna Savdo LLC in Samarkand. He has worked there since March 2016 and has been senior manager since 2020; in 2025 he grew the customer base by 40%, and in 2024 he was named employee of the year. No disciplinary penalties, no complaints. Signed by the director B. S. Toshmatov and the head of HR N. A. Karimova.

finished.uz: 📄 Tavsifnoma tayyor. Bu qoralama: u faqat tashkilot rahbarining imzosi va muhri bilan kuchga kiradi, undagi har bir ma’lumot haqiqatga mos bo‘lishi shart. Imzo qo‘yuvchi, sana va muhr o‘rni faqat siz yozganicha qoldirildi.
finished.ru: 📄 Характеристика готова. Это черновик: она вступает в силу только с подписью и печатью руководителя организации, и каждое утверждение в ней должно быть правдой. Подписанты, дата и место печати оставлены только такими, как вы их указали.
finished.en: 📄 Your reference is ready. It is a draft: it takes effect only with the signature and seal of the issuing organisation, and every statement in it must be true. Signers, date and seal are left exactly as you typed them.

blanks.uz: Siz bermagan ma’lumot o‘rniga bo‘sh chiziq qoldirildi: uni qo‘lda to‘ldiring.
blanks.ru: Где сведений не было, оставлены пустые линии: заполните их от руки.
blanks.en: Where you gave no details, blank lines were left for you to fill in by hand.

shorter.uz: Xabaringizdagi ma’lumot so‘ralgan sahifalarga yetmadi, shuning uchun tavsifnoma qisqaroq chiqdi. Ma’lumot qo‘shsangiz, to‘ldiramiz.
shorter.ru: Сведений из сообщения не хватило на заказанные страницы, поэтому характеристика короче. Добавьте сведения — мы дополним её.
shorter.en: Your message did not have enough facts for the pages asked, so the reference is shorter. Add facts and we will fill it out.

gates: A native Uzbek reader checks the fixed words (TAVSIFNOMA, haqida, the presentation formula, M.O‘., the date pattern, the captions) and the third-person register of the samples; a native Russian reader the Russian ones, including the accusative subject lines ("на ученика ..."); a native English reader the English ones.

Render the school, university first-person, court and mahalla cases and the blank case in uz, ru and en with the paper sample tool and compare them with units/pdf.xat.tavsifnoma/mock/official_tavsifnoma.png and its ru-en and variants sheets.

later.text: Sending a text over the one-page ceiling back to the model once to shorten it; this round the fit steps the type down and lets the paper flow onto a second page.
The extra lines of the finished message for a first-person request (the signer must check the facts) and for more than three signers (the first three were kept).
The Russian form of an Uzbek patronymic (Каримовна or Карим кизи): an owner decision; until then the customer's own form is kept, in the paper's script.
